title: 第1章  全力以赴，才是对捞女的最大尊重
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
“陆渊，你一个大男人怎能如此斤斤计较？”
“我只是要你把直升名额让给我弟弟，怎么弄得好像我占你便宜一样？”
屋内，林嫚儿一袭轻纱罗裙，温润的眸子中满是委屈。
陆渊看着眼前的少女，神情一阵恍惚，两股记忆在脑海中逐渐交叠。
大乾王朝，妖魔乱世，邪祟丛生。
前身是云安县一小卒，幼年丧母，父亲是县衙里的差役。
七岁那年，一只蝠妖杀入县城，父亲为了保护城中百姓，被活生生吸成了一具干尸。
后来镇魔司来人，斩了那妖，收了尸骸，此事便告一段落。
县太爷看他孤苦，又念他父亲是衙门里的老人，便让他在十五岁时子承父业，在县衙做了个站堂的皂吏。
这一站，就是五年。
五年下来，他对镇魔司是愈发神往。
在县衙当差，月俸只有二两银子。
可若能被选入镇魔司，至少都是五两银子打底。
镇魔司衙役，穿的是刀剑难伤的墨黑锦袍，修的是斩妖除魔的杀生法，腰间那把横刀更是普通人一辈子也摸不到的法器。
走在县城街上，来往的商贩会主动打招呼，就连街边吃碗素面，摊主也会多加二两肉沫。
畏惧是一方面，更重要的是，镇魔司真能救命。
妖魔作祟，他们是真敢杀。
就算受伤也有专门的医房，用的更是掺了灵药的膏子。
即便是被妖魔杀死，家属也能领一百两抚恤银。
一百两啊！

抵得上普通人家好几年的吃穿用度了！
放在以前，前身根本不敢想这些。
毕竟他资质平庸，能在这妖魔乱世混口饭吃就不错了。
可今年开春，镇魔司在各州县选拔新血，又加了一条新规。
凡忠烈之后，可免去选拔直升镇魔司。
前身的父亲在县衙当差，被妖魔所杀，这直升名额自然是有他一份。
消息传开，林嫚儿第一个登门，但并不是来道贺。
“陆渊，你能不能把镇魔司的直升名额......让给林辰？”
“你知道的，我弟弟天赋极佳，若他能进入镇魔司，将来一定会出人头地！”
陆渊不语，神情中的恍惚逐渐清明。
他看向眼前的少女，鹅蛋脸，一双杏眼含着水光，一看就是个美人坯子。
这模样，难怪能把前身吊成翘嘴。
整整五年！
县衙发给前身的那点儿俸禄，全都被这女人搜刮干净了。
最开始只是小事。
“陆渊哥哥，绣坊扣了我工钱，你能不能借我五十文？你放心，下个月发了工钱我一定还你！”
前身借了。
他月俸二两银子，这五十文对他来说根本不算什么。
林嫚儿接过钱，道了谢，对他笑了笑。
就这一笑，前身觉得值了。

到了下个月，她没还钱，下下个月，也没还。
再下个月，前身也就没想这回事了，只想着她多笑几次。
后来，小事变成大事。
她的弟弟林辰想拜一名退隐的老捕头为师，要交束脩，十两银子。
林嫚儿红着眼眶来找陆渊，说她实在没办法了，说家里凑不出，说林辰要是错过了这个机会这辈子就毁了。
前身将家中积蓄全部拿了出来，凑了八两，又去当铺当了他爹生前用的横刀，凑够十两。
当他把十两银子交给林嫚儿的时候，她的手在他手心多停留了一瞬。
就这一瞬，前身觉得那把刀当的值。
林辰拜师是为了学武，从此开销就更大了。
买草药要钱，熬筋骨要钱，孝敬师父更是要钱......
后来林嫚儿又说，林辰练得是正儿八经的功夫，天天吃素力气上不去，想把功夫练好就必须吃肉。
从那时起，前身的银子就像流水一样进了林嫚儿的口袋。
林嫚儿也总有办法让他掏钱。
有时候是为林辰买草药，有时候是林辰练功受了伤，有时候是林辰请师兄们喝酒......
有时候什么也不说，只是在他面前红着眼眶叹一口气，前身就乖乖将银子送了出去。
这些钱，林嫚儿一个铜板都没舍得自己用，全花在了弟弟林辰的身上。
林家老爹咽气前的最后一句话，就是嘱托林嫚儿照顾好弟弟。
从那时起她就知道，弟弟是林家唯一的希望。
所以她拼了命地从前身那里捞钱。
直到今天，她得知陆渊能以忠烈之后的身份直升镇魔司。

这一刻，她终于看到了弟弟出人头地的机会。
“陆渊，你不是说喜欢我吗？那就把直升名额让给我弟弟吧！”
“我平时没求过你什么，这一次，就当我求你好不好？”
“你是个好人，我会记你一辈子的！”
陆渊眉头微皱，眼底流露出毫不掩饰的厌恶。
都穿越了还能遇见捞女？
骗钱骗感情也就算了，这名额可是前身那差役老爹用命换来的！
这是要把他当绝户吃啊！
“不可能。”
陆渊一口回绝，他可不是前身那个舔狗了。
“什么？”
林嫚儿惊呼一声，脸上浮现出几分疑惑。
怎么回事？
放在以往，只要她一句话，陆渊恨不得把心掏出来给她看。
今天竟然唱反调？
“陆渊，我实话告诉你吧，你资质平平，就算进了镇魔司也是送死。”
“可林辰不一样，他资质极佳，将来若是能在镇魔司中谋个校尉之职，到时候也能对你照拂一二！”
对我照拂一二？
我资质平平？
陆渊心中一阵荒谬，直接气笑了。

林嫚儿娇哼一声，语气又冷了几分。
“陆渊，你不是说喜欢我吗？难道你就是这样喜欢的？”
“不过是一个名额而已，我对你真的太失望了，原来你所谓的喜欢是如此自私！”
她上前一步，有恃无恐。
“陆渊，如果你真的喜欢我，就把名额让给我弟弟，这样我还会考虑给你一个机会。”
“否则，以后你别想再见到我。”
“滚你妈的！”
陆渊根本不惯着，一巴掌抽了上去。
前身是个舔狗，他可不是。
这一下没有收力，林嫚儿整个人都跌飞出去。
全力以赴，才是对捞女最大的尊重。
下一秒，虚幻的光幕出现在陆渊眼前。

content_en:
"Lu Yuan, how can a grown man like you be so fussy?"
"I just want you to give up your direct promotion spot to my brother. Why do you make it look like I'm taking advantage of you?"
Inside the house, Lin Man'er was wearing a light gauze skirt, her warm eyes full of grievances.
Lu Yuan looked at the girl in front of him, his expression was in a trance, and the two memories gradually overlapped in his mind.
During the Daqian Dynasty, the world was filled with demons and evil spirits.
His predecessor was a soldier in Yun'an County. His mother died when he was young, and his father was a servant in the county government.
When he was seven years old, a bat demon entered the county town. In order to protect the people in the city, his father was sucked alive and turned into a mummy.
Later, someone from the Demon Suppression Department came, killed the demon and collected the body, and the matter came to an end.
The county magistrate saw that he was lonely and thought that his father was an old man in the government office, so he asked him to inherit his father's business when he was fifteen years old and work as a clerk in the county government office.
This stop lasts for five years.
Over the past five years, he has become increasingly fascinated by the Demon Suppression Division.
Working as an errand in the county government, his monthly salary was only two taels of silver.
But if you can be selected into the Demon Suppressing Division, you will have at least five taels of silver as a foundation.
The servant of the Demon Suppression Department wears a jet-black brocade robe that is hard to be damaged by swords. He practices the killing method of slaying demons and killing demons. The horizontal sword on his waist is a magic weapon that ordinary people will never be able to touch.
When walking on the streets of the county town, vendors will greet each other proactively. Even when eating a bowl of plain noodles on the street, the stall owner will add an extra two ounces of minced meat.
Fear is one thing, but more importantly, the Demon Suppressor can really save lives.
Demons are causing trouble, and they really dare to kill them.
Even if you are injured, there is a special medical room, and the ointment mixed with elixir is used.
Even if he is killed by a demon, his family members can receive one hundred taels of silver as a pension.
One hundred taels!
It is equivalent to the food and clothing expenses of an ordinary family for several years!
In the past, my predecessor would never have dared to think about this.
After all, he has mediocre qualifications, so it would be great if he could make a living in this troubled world.
But in the spring of this year, the Demon-Suppressing Division selected new blood from various states and counties and added a new rule.
After becoming a loyal warrior, you can be directly promoted to the Demon Suppression Division without the need for selection.
My predecessor's father was an errand in the county government and was killed by a demon. Naturally, he had a share of the direct promotion quota.
When the news spread, Lin Man'er was the first to visit, but not to congratulate her.
"Lu Yuan, can you give up the direct promotion spot to the Demon Suppression Division to Lin Chen?"
"You know, my brother is extremely talented. If he can enter the Demon Suppression Division, he will definitely be successful in the future!"
Lu Yuan remained silent, the trance in his expression gradually clearing up.
He looked at the girl in front of him. She had an oval face and a pair of almond-shaped eyes. She looked like a beauty at first glance.
With this look, it’s no wonder that she can make her lips curl up in front of her body.
Five whole years!
The little salary that the county government paid to my predecessor was all plundered by this woman.
It started out as little things.
"Brother Lu Yuan, the embroidery workshop has deducted my wages, can you lend me fifty coins? Don't worry, I will definitely pay you back when my wages are paid next month!"
The predecessor was borrowed.
His monthly salary is two taels of silver, and this fifty coins is nothing to him.
Lin Man'er took the money, thanked him, and smiled at him.
Just this smile, the predecessor felt it was worth it.
The next month, she didn't pay back the money, and the next month, she didn't pay back the money.
Next month, my predecessor will no longer think about this matter, and will only think about her smiling a few more times.
Later, small things turned into big things.
Her younger brother Lin Chen wanted to become a disciple of a retired old catcher, and he wanted to pay Shuxiu ten taels of silver.
Lin Man'er came to Lu Yuan with red eyes, saying that she really had no choice, that her family couldn't make ends meet, and that if Lin Chen missed this opportunity, his life would be ruined.
The predecessor took out all the savings at home and scraped together eight taels. He then went to a pawn shop to pawn the horizontal knife his father had used before his death, and scraped together ten taels.
When he handed the ten taels of silver to Lin Man'er, her hand stayed in his palm for a moment longer.
At this moment, the predecessor felt that the knife was worth it.
Lin Chen became a disciple to learn martial arts, and the expenses became even greater from then on.
It costs money to buy herbs, and it costs money to cook bones and muscles., being filial to Master requires money...
Later, Lin Man'er said that Lin Chen was practicing serious Kung Fu. He couldn't gain strength by eating vegetarian food every day. If he wanted to practice Kung Fu well, he had to eat meat.
From then on, the money from his predecessor flowed into Lin Man'er's pocket like running water.
Lin Man'er always had a way to make him pay.
Sometimes it was to buy herbs for Lin Chen, sometimes it was Lin Chen who got injured while practicing, sometimes it was Lin Chen who invited his senior brothers to drink...
Sometimes I didn't say anything, I just sighed with red eyes in front of him, and then the predecessor obediently gave away the money.
Lin Man'er was not willing to use even a cent of this money for herself, and spent it all on her younger brother Lin Chen.
The last words the Lin family's father said before he died was to ask Lin Man'er to take good care of his younger brother.
From then on, she knew that her younger brother was the Lin family's only hope.
So she desperately tried to get money from her predecessor.
Until today, she learned that Lu Yuan could be directly promoted to the Demon Suppressing Division as a loyal lieutenant.
At this moment, she finally saw her brother's opportunity to get ahead.
"Lu Yuan, didn't you say you like me? Then give up the direct promotion spot to my brother!"
"I haven't asked you for anything usually. This time, just treat it like I'm begging you, okay?"
"You are a good person and I will remember you forever!"
Lu Yuan frowned slightly, his eyes showing undisguised disgust.
After traveling through time, can I still meet a girl?
Forget about cheating money and feelings, this position was earned with the life of my predecessor, the policeman!
This is to treat him like a destitute person!
"No way."
Lu Yuan refused. He was no longer the licking dog of his predecessor.
"What?"
Lin Man'er exclaimed, with some confusion on her face.
What's going on?
In the past, as long as she said a word, Lu Yuan could not wait to show her his heart.
Are you actually singing the opposite tune today?
"Lu Yuan, let me tell you the truth. Your qualifications are mediocre. Even if you join the Demon Suppression Division, you will die."
"But Lin Chen is different. He has excellent qualifications. If he can find a position as a captain in the Demon Suppression Division in the future, he will be able to look after you!"
Take care of me?
My qualifications are mediocre?
Lu Yuan felt ridiculous in his heart and laughed angrily.
Lin Man'er snorted, her tone a little colder.
"Lu Yuan, didn't you say you like me? Is this how you like me?"
"It's just a quota. I'm really disappointed in you. It turns out that your so-called love is so selfish!"
She took a step forward, feeling confident.
"Lu Yuan, if you really like me, give up your spot to my brother, so that I will consider giving you a chance."
"Otherwise, you won't want to see me again in the future."
"Get the fuck out of here!"
Lu Yuan was not used to it at all and slapped him.
His predecessor was a bitch, but he is not.
This time, she failed to hold back her strength, and Lin Man'er fell completely.
Going all out is the greatest respect for women.
The next second, an illusory light curtain appeared in front of Lu Yuan.
